## About Me

I am a software engineering student focused on building practical software systems, backend applications, and AI-powered products.

I enjoy turning ideas into working systems — from APIs and business applications to AI-assisted developer tools — while continuously learning, experimenting, and improving my engineering skills.

## Current Focus

| Area | What I am exploring |
| --- | --- |
| **Software Engineering** | Building maintainable software systems, APIs, business logic, and applications. |
| **Backend Development** | Designing APIs, authentication, databases, business logic, and multi-layer application architectures. |
| **Applied AI** | Integrating modern AI models into practical applications, automation workflows, and developer tools. |
| **Product Building** | Turning ideas into functional products by combining engineering, architecture, and user-focused design. |

## Featured Work

| Project | Focus | Why it matters |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [**Next AI Draw.io**](https://github.com/IsmaelFarah88/next-ai-draw-io) | AI & Developer Tools | An AI-powered diagramming application that lets users create and modify draw.io diagrams through natural language. |
| [**ClinicSystemAPI**](https://github.com/IsmaelFarah88/ClinicSystemAPI) | Backend & API Architecture | A clinic management REST API built with ASP.NET Core 8 using JWT authentication, Entity Framework Core, validation, middleware, and 3-tier architecture. |
| [**Case-study**](https://github.com/IsmaelFarah88/Case-study) | AI Application | An AI-powered web application built with modern frontend tooling and Gemini API integration. |

## Research Direction

I am interested in combining software engineering with modern AI capabilities to build useful, reliable, and practical applications.
